resourceTitle: Tool Calling Is Not Production Readiness
subtitle: What has to exist around an agent's function calls

sections.heading: Tool calling gives you
sections.body: A function call with a schema and structured arguments.

sections.heading: Production asks more
bullets: What if the call times out?

sections.heading: The ticket example
sections.body: If ticket creation times out, the retry may create a duplicate unless the workflow knows what happened.

sections.heading: The useful outcome
sections.body: You can explain what ran, what failed, what retried, and where the workflow should continue.

sections.heading: Workshop
sections.body: Nicholas Lotz will cover this on June 16, 4:30-6:00 PM GMT+2.
